tool_signatures.name: add_domain
tool_signatures.description: Adds a custom domain to a Sevalla application or static site and returns the DNS records to create at the DNS provider. Sevalla then verifies them and issues SSL; get_application or get_static_site shows the status.

tool_signatures.name: create_application
tool_signatures.description: Creates a Sevalla application from a Git repository or Docker image with one web process, and by default starts its first deployment. It is billed by the size and number of its process instances.

tool_signatures.name: create_database
tool_signatures.description: Creates a managed Sevalla database (billed by size). Its password is generated on the server and never returned. connect_to_application_id also connects it to that application and stores the connection URL in the application variable env_var_name, unless that variable already exists. Provisioning is asynchronous; get_database shows when it is ready.

tool_signatures.name: create_static_site
tool_signatures.description: Creates a Sevalla static site from a Git repository and starts its first build. Omitted build settings are detected automatically.

tool_signatures.name: delete_environment_variables
tool_signatures.description: Deletes environment variables by key from a Sevalla application, static site or the company-wide global set. Changes apply at the next deployment.

tool_signatures.name: get_deployment
tool_signatures.description: Returns a deployment of a Sevalla application or static site: status, steps, branch, commit, image, build error and timing. It reports the progress of deployments started by trigger_deployment or rollback_deployment. Output: get_deployment_logs.

tool_signatures.name: get_deployment_logs
tool_signatures.description: Returns the build and rollout log of a deployment of a Sevalla application or static site, one line per entry, by default the last 100 lines. errors_only keeps lines with an error severity or mentioning errors, failures or exceptions. Running application logs: search_runtime_logs.

tool_signatures.name: list_deployments
tool_signatures.description: Lists deployments of a Sevalla application or static site, newest first, with status, trigger, branch, commit and timing.

tool_signatures.name: list_environment_variables
tool_signatures.description: Lists the environment variables of a Sevalla application, static site or the company-wide global set, with their build, runtime, preview and branch scoping. Stored values are withheld.

tool_signatures.name: rollback_deployment
tool_signatures.description: Rolls a Sevalla application or static site back to an earlier successful deployment, reusing its build. Applications return to their most recent successful deployment; static sites to deployment_id or, by default, the last successful one before the current. get_deployment reports progress.

tool_signatures.name: scale_process
tool_signatures.description: Sets how a Sevalla application process scales: fixed instances or an autoscaling range, and/or its machine size. Bigger sizes and more instances cost more. By default the application restarts from its current build so the change applies now.

tool_signatures.name: set_environment_variables
tool_signatures.description: Creates or updates environment variables of a Sevalla application, static site or the company-wide global set; other variables stay unchanged and values are never echoed. Changes apply at the next deployment.

tool_signatures.name: sevalla_api_create
tool_signatures.description: Runs one operation of the ${docsLink} that only adds something new, by operation ID: a project, pipeline, process, backup, bucket, webhook, load balancer and the like. New resources may be billed.

tool_signatures.name: sevalla_api_delete
tool_signatures.description: Permanently deletes one resource through an operation of the ${docsLink} by operation ID: from a domain, process, backup, webhook or API key up to an entire application, static site, database, pipeline, project, load balancer or bucket.

tool_signatures.name: sevalla_api_read
tool_signatures.description: Runs one read-only (GET) operation of the ${docsLink} by operation ID, for data without a dedicated tool: projects, pipelines, load balancers, buckets, webhooks, usage alerts, repository files, users, API keys and more.

tool_signatures.name: sevalla_api_search
tool_signatures.description: Searches all ${OPERATIONS.length} operations of the Sevalla API v3 (reference: ${API_DOCS_URL}), including those behind dedicated tools, by keywords and returns their IDs, parameters, body fields and the tool that runs each. ${OPERATIONS.filter(isExecutable).length} have no dedicated tool, among them the clone, suspend, cancel and promote operations. operation_id returns one operation in full. It reads the API reference, not the account.

tool_signatures.name: sevalla_api_update
tool_signatures.description: Runs one operation of the ${docsLink} that changes existing state, by operation ID: settings updates, suspend or activate, database restart or backup restore, pipeline promotion, cache purges, maintenance mode, or a command in a running process (execProcessCommandV3).

tool_signatures.name: trigger_deployment
tool_signatures.description: Starts a deployment of a Sevalla application or static site: by default the latest commit of the default branch. It runs asynchronously and replaces the running version when it succeeds; get_deployment reports progress.
